lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai hath vadiaaeeaa de naame laae ||
lines.translation: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan man vasiaa vadiaaee paae ||8||4||26||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man ma(n)n vasaai too(n) aape aai milai mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet with you, O my Sibling of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sachee bhagat kar sachai chit laaee ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko naam dhiaai too(n) sukh paavahi mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai doojaa door kar vadee vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is bhagatee no sur nar mun jan lochade vin satigur paaee na jaai ||
lines.translation: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru, it cannot be attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paRade jotikee tin boojh na paai ||2||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai thai sabh rakhion kichh kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape dei s paaeeai gur boojh bujhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tis de sabhanaa kaa soee ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai je doojaa hoee ||4||
lines.translation: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: iko hukam varatadaa ekaa sir kaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aap bhavaalee diteean a(n)tar lobh vikaaraa ||5||
lines.translation: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape guramukh keetian boojhan veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhee onaa no bakhaseean a(n)tar bha(n)daaraa ||6||
lines.translation: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaaneeaa no sabh sach hai sach sojhee hoee ||
lines.translation: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: oi bhulaae kisai de na bhulanhee sach jaanan soee ||7||
lines.translation: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar mahi pa(n)ch varatade pa(n)che veechaaree ||
lines.translation: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satigur vas na aavanhee naam haumai maaree ||8||5||27||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gharai a(n)dar sabh vath hai baahar kichh naahee ||
lines.translation: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai a(n)tar kapat khulaahee ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te har paaeeai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai poorai satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa gaahak hovai so lae paae ratan veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar kholai dib disat dekhai mukat bha(n)daaraa ||2||
lines.translation: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar mahal anek hahi jeeu kare vaseraa ||
lines.translation: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaisee phir hoi na pheraa ||3||
lines.translation: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarakheeaa vath samaal laee gur sojhee hoee ||
lines.translation: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath amul saa guramukh paavai koee ||4||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaale s kiaa lahai vath gharai a(n)dar bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhoolaa sabh jag phirai manamukh pat gavaaee ||5||
lines.translation: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar dar chhode aapanaa par ghar jhoothaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: chorai vaa(n)goo pakaReeai bin naavai chotaa khaaee ||6||
lines.translation: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee ghar jaataa aapanaa se sukheee bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar braham pachhaaniaa gur kee vadiaaee ||7||
lines.translation: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape daan kare kis aakheeai aape dei bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can we complain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai too(n) dar sachai sobhaa paaee ||8||6||28||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||
